title: What happened down there?
notes: Late June: the county died in two days, watched from orbit. Tier 2 is the Doctor's
half a signature (the channel's SCIENCE). The dead were people (LORE.md 1c); she
does not joke about them and does not preach about them either.

lines.text: Late June. Two days. We watched it from orbit.
It started in Knox County and went out from there.
She doesn't say what the sensors counted.
Nothing in our database spreads like that. Nothing natural.
Five months after somebody blinded this ship. I don't like that.

options.text: What are they now? The dead.
What does your medical staff say?

lines.text: Dead. The ones that walk are dead, whatever they look like.
Doctor Anwar is sure of that much. They don't come back.
Every one of them lived in that county a month ago.
The crew don't joke about them. I'd take it badly if you did.
That it isn't in any database we carry. They're still working.
Shepard has the Doctor on it too. He'll call her before me.
The Doctor found morphogenic markers in the samples.
Chemistry for changing shape. And something else he couldn't place.
He says he's reading half a signature. He hates saying it.
I can support the chemistry, he said. Not the author.
